introHtml: BEL luggage ID tags offer a durable, professional option for businesses needing reliable identification solutions. Whether you choose leather, RFID-blocking, or slip-in styles, these tags withstand travel wear while keeping your brand visible. Ideal for corporate gifts, trade shows, or employee travel kits, BEL tags provide customization with debossed logos or full-color printing for a polished look that stands out at baggage claim.
